name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For safety, if ptr was returned by Arc<U>::into_raw and U is sized, U must have the same size and alignment as T.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::sync::Arc < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: Cannot express this requirement in the supplied DSL: the historical origin of ptr and the sizedness, size, and alignment of U are not observable.
